title: xongolo too gexkalootu sanamul amoytiino
intro: Yallih farmoytit fanak numma xayyoosoonuh giddile agattiinah fanat ugutteh tan diggale taama abeynit sugte. ken ummatta oggolteh sugte ginnimteh tan rabbitte, wonnah fakkimte gineenak inkih taniimi. Calli sinni fidga luk, ta numtin amoh seeceh — takkay immay farmo diggoysak, diggoysak sugte. tama diggale taama abeynit miyya kinnim cedoonuh rortitte fanah maaqatta bey.
clues: anu farmoyti akkuk ruubeh suge giddile ummattay massat yan gitak baxxo le.
Anu inni agat inkih tan ginook inkih gine num kassisuh emeetem — inkih tan ginook tayse num.
Yi ummatta bar kee loqo yassakaxxeenim kee seecan dirab sanamitte fan yuduureh suge.
Anu ken gexkalit libdo luk, essereh macaay oson bicsen rabbi kah qibaadah kee ken numma degelta cabaanam.
Oson yoo diggalsimak, yoo yaabbeenim cineenih, sinni dirab diggalsimak — uxih yi Rabbi yoo dacriseh.
Anu Ilyas — kee salaam yoh yeceeh, anu kaadu Racmatta le numih taama abeynit fanat lowsiise.
